subject: HelixMed kickoff: activation readiness and steward assignment
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: HelixMed Ops <ops@helixmed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: HelixMed kickoff: activation readiness and steward assignment

Hi Emma / Helix Ops team,

Great to sign this over the weekend — excited to get the pilot moving. Attaching the signed SOW and our standard implementation checklist to this thread. High-level timeline we discussed:
- Pilot start window: week of Jun 14 (target: Jun 15)
- Pilot acceptance window: 2 weeks after pilot start
- Production go-live target: Jul 6 (post-acceptance)

Key asks for the Ops team before our kickoff:
1) Confirm whether the sandbox environment will be available by Jun 10 and provide service account details.
2) Share any firewall / IP allowlist requirements for outbound traffic to our ingestion endpoints.
3) Let us know if the sample dataset will be anonymized or if we need to run a PII scrub.

Internal notes for CS/Solutions (cc'd): please see the checklist and confirm owners below. Proposed assignments: Marissa — Engagement Lead; Vivek — Solutions Architect. Ben, happy to keep supporting as deal steward until handoff.

Next step: would like to lock a 60-minute kickoff the week of Jun 7 to walk through roles, acceptance criteria, and integration plan. I linked a provisional invite in the related links; Emma, can you propose 2x 60-minute slots?

Attachments: SOW_HelixMed_v1.pdf, helixmed_implementation_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mailto:tessa_morgan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

From: Emma Li <emma@helixmed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixMed Ops <ops@helixmed.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixMed kickoff: activation readiness and steward assignment

Thanks Tessa — congrats to both teams. A couple quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

- Sandbox: we can provision a sandbox but it will likely be a partial dataset (PHI redacted). Is that OK for the pilot?
- Firewall: our security team requires a short IP range for allowlisting; I can have that by Thursday.
- Go-live window: our internal PMs prefer a go-live after Jul 6 if there are any outstanding regulatory checks; can we mark Jul 6 as a soft target?

Also — does Redwood have a standard SOC2 evidence packet or a data processing addendum we can review in parallel? We want to get legal looped in early.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: HelixMed handoff notes and steward assignment (internal)

Team — quick internal note to capture context and risks before we hand this to CS:

Context:
- Deal: HelixMed (DEAL-78342). Mid-market healthtech customer, processing clinical summaries to surface care gaps. They committed to a 2-week pilot focused on accuracy on our reranker and entailment checks.
- Tech: They will push anonymized extracts to our ingestion endpoint. Expected token volumes: ~45M tokens/month in pilot, scaling to ~200M after Q3.
- Legal: Emma asked for SOC2 evidence and DPA — we should route those to Customer Trust (I'll attach the standard packet).

Known risks / open items:
- Sandbox readiness timeline (customer: Jun 10) — if delayed, pilot pushes and may cascade to go-live.
- Data sensitivity: we need clarity on whether PHI will be present in the sample; if yes, we must confirm our by-design encryption and KMS usage with the security team.
- Integration window: customer prefers limited maintenance windows (US PST evenings) — may affect ingestion cutovers.

Proposed owner assignment (please confirm):
- Engagement Lead / PO: Marissa Cole (primary customer contact for onboarding milestones)
- Solutions Architect: Vivek Kulkarni (integration, capacity plan, SLOs)
- Deal steward until handoff complete: Ben Carter

Suggested immediate actions:
1) Marissa to schedule formal kickoff with HelixMed stakeholders and include Product Ops (30m pre-kickoff sync with Redwood internal team).
2) Vivek to draft integration runbook and required firewall/IP list.
3) Tessa to share signed SOW in HubSpot and confirm billing contact.

If Marissa/Vivek confirm, I'll update the HubSpot deal notes and move to "Implementation: Ready to schedule" stage.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@helixmed.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixMed kickoff: activation readiness and steward assignment

Thanks all — happy to take point as Engagement Lead for HelixMed. Agreed on the proposed owners and the immediate actions. Quick plan of record:

1) Internal prep (Jun 3–4): Vivek and I will run a 30-minute internal tech/ops prebrief (invite to follow). Vivek, can you confirm whether you need any additional logs/sample payloads from the sales QA?
2) Customer kickoff (propose Jun 9 or Jun 10, 60m): walk through acceptance criteria, data mapping, and sandbox access. Emma — either date works for us; please confirm preferred slot.
3) Deliverables before pilot: integration runbook, access guide, and a trimmed acceptance test set (we'll help synthesize from their sample).
4) Escalation path: for capacity or regression issues, reach out to Vivek (primary) and Ben (secondary); for compliance/legal, I'll loop Customer Trust (CC'd on the follow-up with SOC2 packet).

I attached a short onboarding checklist (subset of the master doc) and will create the kickoff calendar invite once Emma confirms date/time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting HelixMed into pilot.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0192
